metrics.name: multi_turn_task_success_v1
metrics.description: Predefined adaptive rubric metric evaluating end-to-end 1-turn goal completion.

metrics.name: multi_turn_trajectory_quality_v1
metrics.description: Predefined adaptive rubric metric evaluating sub-agent routing trajectory (engage -> specialist).

metrics.name: tool_use_quality
metrics.description: Custom LLM-as-a-Judge metric evaluating external google_search tool usage on filter_smart without confusing workflow sub-agents with tools.

metrics.name: coherence
metrics.description: Coherence metric evaluating logical flow, clarity, and organization of the response.

metrics.name: schema_and_contract_valid
metrics.description: Deterministic Python metric validating ConversationalOutput Pydantic schema, decision-field invariants, and non-hallucinated flight subsets.

metrics.name: conversation_plan_alignment
metrics.description: Custom LLM-as-a-Judge metric grading whether the ConversationalOutput JSON matches the expected ground truth in conversation_plan.

metrics.name: latency_seconds
metrics.description: End-to-end 1-turn application response latency in seconds (lower is better; threshold is max acceptable latency in seconds).

metrics.name: cost_per_1k_requests_usd
metrics.description: Estimated Vertex AI Standard PayGo total SUT cost per 1,000 requests in USD, combining LLM input/cached/output/thinking tokens and Gemini 3 per-query Google Search grounding ($14/1k queries).

metrics.name: llm_token_cost_per_1k_usd
metrics.description: Estimated Vertex AI Standard PayGo LLM token-only cost per 1,000 requests in USD (isolating model, prompt, caching, and thinking token efficiency from Google Search grounding fees).

metrics.name: total_billable_tokens
metrics.description: Total LLM tokens consumed per request across all executed sub-agents (prompt + tool_use_prompt + candidates_output + thoughts).
